title: General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) Schedule
recordDescription: Static transit schedules and geography: agencies, stops, routes, trips, stop times, service calendars, shapes, frequencies, transfers and feed metadata.

fields.name: agency.agency_id
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Identifies a transit brand which is often synonymous with a transit agency. Note that in some cases, such as when a single agency operates multiple separate services, agencies and brands are distinct. This document uses the term "agency" in place of "brand".

fields.name: agency.agency_name
fields.description: (Required) Full name of the transit agency.

fields.name: agency.agency_url
fields.description: (Required) URL of the transit agency.

fields.name: agency.agency_timezone
fields.description: (Required) Timezone where the transit agency is located. If multiple agencies are specified in the dataset, each must have the same agency_timezone.

fields.name: agency.agency_lang
fields.description: (Optional) Primary language used by this transit agency. Should be provided to help GTFS consumers choose capitalization rules and other language-specific settings for the dataset.

fields.name: agency.agency_phone
fields.description: (Optional) A voice telephone number for the specified agency. This field is a string value that presents the telephone number as typical for the agency's service area. It may contain punctuation marks to group the digits of the number.

fields.name: agency.agency_fare_url
fields.description: (Optional) URL of a web page where a rider can purchase tickets or other fare instruments for that agency, or a web page containing information about that agency's fares.

fields.name: agency.agency_email
fields.description: (Optional) Email address actively monitored by the agency’s customer service department. This email address should be a direct contact point where transit riders can reach a customer service representative at the agency.

fields.name: agency.cemv_support
fields.description: (Optional) Indicates if riders can access a transit service (i.e., trip) associated with this agency by using a contactless EMV (Europay, Mastercard, and Visa) card or mobile device as fare media at a fare validator (such as in pay-as-you-go or open-loop systems).

fields.name: stops.stop_id
fields.description: (Required) Identifies a location: stop/platform, station, entrance/exit, generic node or boarding area (see location_type). ID must be unique across all stops.stop_id, locations.geojson id, and location_groups.location_group_id values. Multiple routes may use the same stop_id.

fields.name: stops.stop_code
fields.description: (Optional) Short text or a number that identifies the location for riders. These codes are often used in phone-based transit information systems or printed on signage to make it easier for riders to get information for a particular location.

fields.name: stops.stop_name
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Name of the location. The stop_name should match the agency's rider-facing name for the location as printed on a timetable, published online, or represented on signage. For translations into other languages, use translations.txt.

fields.name: stops.tts_stop_name
fields.description: (Optional) Readable version of the stop_name. See "Text-to-speech field" in the Term Definitions for more.

fields.name: stops.stop_desc
fields.description: (Optional) Description of the location that provides useful, quality information. Should not be a duplicate of stop_name.

fields.name: stops.stop_lat
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Latitude of the location. For stops/platforms (location_type=0) and boarding area (location_type=4), the coordinates must be the ones of the bus pole — if exists — and otherwise of where the travelers are boarding the vehicle (on the sidewalk or the platform, and not on…

fields.name: stops.stop_lon
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Longitude of the location. For stops/platforms (location_type=0) and boarding area (location_type=4), the coordinates must be the ones of the bus pole — if exists — and otherwise of where the travelers are boarding the vehicle (on the sidewalk or the platform, and not on…

fields.name: stops.zone_id
fields.description: (Optional) Identifies the fare zone for a stop. If this record represents a station or station entrance, the zone_id is ignored.

fields.name: stops.stop_url
fields.description: (Optional) URL of a web page about the location. This should be different from the agency.agency_url and the routes.route_url field values.

fields.name: stops.location_type
fields.description: (Optional) Location type. Valid options are: 0 (or empty) - Stop (or Platform). A location where passengers board or disembark from a transit vehicle. Is called a platform when defined within a parent_station. 1 - Station. A physical structure or area that contains one or more platform.

fields.name: stops.parent_station
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Defines hierarchy between the different locations defined in stops.txt. It contains the ID of the parent location, as followed: - Stop/platform (location_type=0): the parent_station field contains the ID of a station. - Station (location_type=1): this field must be empty.

fields.name: stops.stop_timezone
fields.description: (Optional) Timezone of the location. If the location has a parent station, it inherits the parent station’s timezone instead of applying its own. Stations and parentless stops with empty stop_timezone inherit the timezone specified by agency.agency_timezone.

fields.name: stops.wheelchair_boarding
fields.description: (Optional) Indicates whether wheelchair boardings are possible from the location. Valid options are: For parentless stops: 0 or empty - No accessibility information for the stop. 1 - Some vehicles at this stop can be boarded by a rider in a wheelchair.

fields.name: stops.level_id
fields.description: (Optional) Level of the location. The same level may be used by multiple unlinked stations.

fields.name: stops.platform_code
fields.description: (Optional) Platform identifier for a platform stop (a stop belonging to a station). This should be just the platform identifier (eg. "G" or "3"). Words like “platform” or "track" (or the feed’s language-specific equivalent) should not be included.

fields.name: stops.stop_access
fields.description: (Conditionally Forbidden) Indicates how the stop is accessed for a particular station. Valid options are: 0 - The stop/platform cannot be directly accessed from the street network. It must be accessed from a station entrance if there is one defined for the station, otherwise the station itself.

fields.name: routes.route_id
fields.description: (Required) Identifies a route.

fields.name: routes.agency_id
fields.description: References `agency.agency_id`. (Conditionally Required) Agency for the specified route. Conditionally Required: - Required if multiple agencies are defined in agency.txt. - Recommended otherwise.

fields.name: routes.route_short_name
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Short name of a route. Often a short, abstract identifier (e.g., "32", "100X", "Green") that riders use to identify a route. Both route_short_name and route_long_name may be defined. Conditionally Required: - Required if routes.route_long_name is empty.

fields.name: routes.route_long_name
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Full name of a route. This name is generally more descriptive than the route_short_name and often includes the route's destination or stop. Both route_short_name and route_long_name may be defined. Conditionally Required: - Required if routes.route_short_name is empty.

fields.name: routes.route_desc
fields.description: (Optional) Description of a route that provides useful, quality information. Should not be a duplicate of route_short_name or route_long_name. _Example: "A" trains operate between Inwood-207 St, Manhattan and Far Rockaway-Mott Avenue, Queens at all times.

fields.name: routes.route_type
fields.description: (Required) Indicates the type of transportation used on a route. Valid options are: 0 - Tram, Streetcar, Light rail. Any light rail or street level system within a metropolitan area. 1 - Subway, Metro. Any underground rail system within a metropolitan area. 2 - Rail.

fields.name: routes.route_url
fields.description: (Optional) URL of a web page about the particular route. Should be different from the agency.agency_url value.

fields.name: routes.route_color
fields.description: (Optional) Route color designation that matches public facing material. Defaults to white (FFFFFF) when omitted or left empty. The color difference between route_color and route_text_color should provide sufficient contrast when viewed on a black and white screen.

fields.name: routes.route_text_color
fields.description: (Optional) Legible color to use for text drawn against a background of route_color. Defaults to black (000000) when omitted or left empty. The color difference between route_color and route_text_color should provide sufficient contrast when viewed on a black and white screen.

fields.name: routes.route_sort_order
fields.description: (Optional) Orders the routes in a way which is ideal for presentation to customers. Routes with smaller route_sort_order values should be displayed first.

fields.name: routes.continuous_pickup
fields.description: (Conditionally Forbidden) Indicates that the rider can board the transit vehicle at any point along the vehicle’s travel path as described by shapes.txt, on every trip of the route. Valid options are: 0 - Continuous stopping pickup. 1 or empty - No continuous stopping pickup.

fields.name: routes.continuous_drop_off
fields.description: (Conditionally Forbidden) Indicates that the rider can alight from the transit vehicle at any point along the vehicle’s travel path as described by shapes.txt, on every trip of the route. Valid options are: 0 - Continuous stopping drop off. 1 or empty - No continuous stopping drop off.

fields.name: trips.route_id
fields.description: (Required) Identifies a route.

fields.name: trips.service_id
fields.description: References `calendar.service_id` or `calendar_dates.service_id`. (Required) Identifies a set of dates when service is available for one or more routes.

fields.name: trips.trip_id
fields.description: (Required) Identifies a trip.

fields.name: trips.trip_headsign
fields.description: (Optional) Text that appears on signage identifying the trip's destination to riders. This field is recommended for all services with headsign text displayed on the vehicle which may be used to distinguish amongst trips in a route.

fields.name: trips.trip_short_name
fields.description: (Optional) Public facing text used to identify the trip to riders, for instance, to identify train numbers for commuter rail trips. If riders do not commonly rely on trip names, trip_short_name should be empty.

fields.name: trips.direction_id
fields.description: (Optional) Indicates the direction of travel for a trip. This field should not be used in routing; it provides a way to separate trips by direction when publishing time tables. Valid options are: 0 - Travel in one direction (e.g. outbound travel). 1 - Travel in the opposite direction (e.g.

fields.name: trips.block_id
fields.description: (Optional) Identifies the block to which the trip belongs. A block consists of a single trip or many sequential trips made using the same vehicle, defined by shared service days and block_id. A block_id may have trips with different service days, making distinct blocks. See the example below.

fields.name: trips.shape_id
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Identifies a geospatial shape describing the vehicle travel path for a trip. Conditionally Required: - Required if the trip has a continuous pickup or drop-off behavior defined either in routes.txt or in stop_times.txt. - Optional otherwise.

fields.name: trips.wheelchair_accessible
fields.description: (Optional) Indicates wheelchair accessibility. Valid options are: 0 or empty - No accessibility information for the trip. 1 - Vehicle being used on this particular trip can accommodate at least one rider in a wheelchair. 2 - No riders in wheelchairs can be accommodated on this trip.

fields.name: trips.bikes_allowed
fields.description: (Optional) Indicates whether bikes are allowed. Valid options are: 0 or empty - No bike information for the trip. 1 - Vehicle being used on this particular trip can accommodate at least one bicycle. 2 - No bicycles are allowed on this trip.

fields.name: trips.cars_allowed
fields.description: (Optional) Indicates whether cars are allowed. Valid options are: 0 or empty - No car information for the trip. 1 - Vehicle being used on this particular trip can accommodate at least one car. 2 - No cars are allowed on this trip.

fields.name: trips.safe_duration_factor
fields.description: (Optional) Multiplier applied to travel time estimates calculated for on-demand trips. See "Calculating on-demand trip time estimates with safe duration fields" section below for guidance on how to use this and the safe_duration_offset fields.

fields.name: trips.safe_duration_offset
fields.description: (Optional) Fixed offset value in seconds applied to travel time estimates calculated for on-demand trips. See "Calculating on-demand trip time estimates with safe duration fields" section below for guidance on how to use this and the safe_duration_factor fields.

fields.name: stop_times.trip_id
fields.description: (Required) Identifies a trip.

fields.name: stop_times.arrival_time
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Arrival time at the stop (defined by stop_times.stop_id) for a specific trip (defined by stop_times.trip_id) in the time zone specified by agency.agency_timezone, not stops.stop_timezone.

fields.name: stop_times.departure_time
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Departure time from the stop (defined by stop_times.stop_id) for a specific trip (defined by stop_times.trip_id) in the time zone specified by agency.agency_timezone, not stops.stop_timezone.

fields.name: stop_times.stop_id
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Identifies the serviced stop. All stops serviced during a trip must have a record in stop_times.txt. Referenced locations must be stops/platforms, i.e. their stops.location_type value must be 0 or empty.

fields.name: stop_times.location_group_id
fields.description: References `location_groups.location_group_id`. (Conditionally Forbidden) Identifies the serviced location group that indicates groups of stops where riders may request pickup or drop off. All location groups serviced during a trip must have a record in stop_times.txt. Multiple trips and routes may service the same location group.

fields.name: stop_times.location_id
fields.description: References `id` from `locations.geojson`. (Conditionally Forbidden) Identifies the GeoJSON location that corresponds to serviced zone where riders may request pickup or drop off. All GeoJSON locations serviced during a trip must have a record in stop_times.txt. Multiple trips and routes may service the same GeoJSON location.

fields.name: stop_times.stop_sequence
fields.description: (Required) Order of stops, location groups, or GeoJSON locations for a particular trip. The values must increase along the trip but do not need to be consecutive.

fields.name: stop_times.stop_headsign
fields.description: (Optional) Text that appears on signage identifying the trip's destination to riders. This field overrides the default trips.trip_headsign when the headsign changes between stops. If the headsign is displayed for an entire trip, trips.trip_headsign should be used instead.

fields.name: stop_times.start_pickup_drop_off_window
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Time that on-demand service becomes available in a GeoJSON location, location group, or stop. Conditionally Required: - Required if stop_times.location_group_id or stop_times.location_id is defined. - Required if end_pickup_drop_off_window is defined.

fields.name: stop_times.end_pickup_drop_off_window
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Time that on-demand service ends in a GeoJSON location, location group, or stop. Conditionally Required: - Required if stop_times.location_group_id or stop_times.location_id is defined. - Required if start_pickup_drop_off_window is defined.

fields.name: stop_times.pickup_type
fields.description: (Conditionally Forbidden) Indicates pickup method. Valid options are: 0 or empty - Regularly scheduled pickup. 1 - No pickup available. 2 - Must phone agency to arrange pickup. 3 - Must coordinate with driver to arrange pickup.

fields.name: stop_times.drop_off_type
fields.description: (Conditionally Forbidden) Indicates drop off method. Valid options are: 0 or empty - Regularly scheduled drop off. 1 - No drop off available. 2 - Must phone agency to arrange drop off. 3 - Must coordinate with driver to arrange drop off.

fields.name: stop_times.continuous_pickup
fields.description: (Conditionally Forbidden) Indicates that the rider can board the transit vehicle at any point along the vehicle’s travel path as described by shapes.txt, from this stop_time to the next stop_time in the trip’s stop_sequence. Valid options are: 0 - Continuous stopping pickup.

fields.name: stop_times.continuous_drop_off
fields.description: (Conditionally Forbidden) Indicates that the rider can alight from the transit vehicle at any point along the vehicle’s travel path as described by shapes.txt, from this stop_time to the next stop_time in the trip’s stop_sequence. Valid options are: 0 - Continuous stopping drop off.

fields.name: stop_times.shape_dist_traveled
fields.description: (Optional) Actual distance traveled along the associated shape, from the first stop to the stop specified in this record. This field specifies how much of the shape to draw between any two stops during a trip. Must be in the same units used in shapes.txt.

fields.name: stop_times.timepoint
fields.description: (Optional) Indicates if arrival and departure times for a stop are strictly adhered to by the vehicle or if they are instead approximate and/or interpolated times. This field allows a GTFS producer to provide interpolated stop-times, while indicating that the times are approximate.

fields.name: stop_times.pickup_booking_rule_id
fields.description: References `booking_rules.booking_rule_id`. (Optional) Identifies the boarding booking rule at this stop time. Recommended when pickup_type=2.

fields.name: stop_times.drop_off_booking_rule_id
fields.description: References `booking_rules.booking_rule_id`. (Optional) Identifies the alighting booking rule at this stop time. Recommended when drop_off_type=2.

fields.name: calendar.service_id
fields.description: (Required) Identifies a set of dates when service is available for one or more routes.

fields.name: calendar.monday
fields.description: (Required) Indicates whether the service operates on all Mondays in the date range specified by the start_date and end_date fields. Note that exceptions for particular dates may be listed in calendar_dates.txt. Valid options are: 1 - Service is available for all Mondays in the date range.

fields.name: calendar.tuesday
fields.description: (Required) Functions in the same way as monday except applies to Tuesdays

fields.name: calendar.wednesday
fields.description: (Required) Functions in the same way as monday except applies to Wednesdays

fields.name: calendar.thursday
fields.description: (Required) Functions in the same way as monday except applies to Thursdays

fields.name: calendar.friday
fields.description: (Required) Functions in the same way as monday except applies to Fridays

fields.name: calendar.saturday
fields.description: (Required) Functions in the same way as monday except applies to Saturdays.

fields.name: calendar.sunday
fields.description: (Required) Functions in the same way as monday except applies to Sundays.

fields.name: calendar.start_date
fields.description: (Required) Start service day for the service interval.

fields.name: calendar.end_date
fields.description: (Required) End service day for the service interval. This service day is included in the interval.

fields.name: calendar_dates.service_id
fields.description: References `calendar.service_id` or ID. (Required) Identifies a set of dates when a service exception occurs for one or more routes. Each (service_id, date) pair may only appear once in calendar_dates.txt if using calendar.txt and calendar_dates.txt in conjunction.

fields.name: calendar_dates.date
fields.description: (Required) Date when service exception occurs.

fields.name: calendar_dates.exception_type
fields.description: (Required) Indicates whether service is available on the date specified in the date field. Valid options are: 1 - Service has been added for the specified date. 2 - Service has been removed for the specified date.

fields.name: shapes.shape_id
fields.description: (Required) Identifies a shape.

fields.name: shapes.shape_pt_lat
fields.description: (Required) Latitude of a shape point. Each record in shapes.txt represents a shape point used to define the shape.

fields.name: shapes.shape_pt_lon
fields.description: (Required) Longitude of a shape point.

fields.name: shapes.shape_pt_sequence
fields.description: (Required) Sequence in which the shape points connect to form the shape. Values must increase along the trip but do not need to be consecutive. *Example: If the shape "A_shp" has three points in its definition, the shapes.txt file might contain these records to define the shape:*…

fields.name: shapes.shape_dist_traveled
fields.description: (Optional) Actual distance traveled along the shape from the first shape point to the point specified in this record. Used by trip planners to show the correct portion of the shape on a map.

fields.name: frequencies.trip_id
fields.description: (Required) Identifies a trip to which the specified headway of service applies.

fields.name: frequencies.start_time
fields.description: (Required) Time at which the first vehicle departs from the first stop of the trip with the specified headway.

fields.name: frequencies.end_time
fields.description: (Required) Time at which service changes to a different headway (or ceases) at the first stop in the trip.

fields.name: frequencies.headway_secs
fields.description: (Required) Time, in seconds, between departures from the same stop (headway) for the trip, during the time interval specified by start_time and end_time. Multiple headways may be defined for the same trip, but must not overlap. New headways may start at the exact time the previous headway ends.

fields.name: frequencies.exact_times
fields.description: (Optional) Indicates the type of service for a trip. See the file description for more information. Valid options are: 0 or empty - Frequency-based trips. 1 - Schedule-based trips with the exact same headway throughout the day.

fields.name: transfers.from_stop_id
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Identifies a stop (location_type=0) or a station (location_type=1) where a connection between routes begins. If this field refers to a station, the transfer rule applies to all its child stops. It must refer to a stop (location_type=0) if transfer_type is 4 or 5.

fields.name: transfers.to_stop_id
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Identifies a stop (location_type=0) or a station (location_type=1) where a connection between routes ends. If this field refers to a station, the transfer rule applies to all child stops. It must refer to a stop (location_type=0) if transfer_type is 4 or 5.

fields.name: transfers.from_route_id
fields.description: (Optional) Identifies a route where a connection begins. If from_route_id is defined, the transfer will apply to the arriving trip on the route for the given from_stop_id.

fields.name: transfers.to_route_id
fields.description: (Optional) Identifies a route where a connection ends. If to_route_id is defined, the transfer will apply to the departing trip on the route for the given to_stop_id. If both to_trip_id and to_route_id are defined, the trip_id must belong to the route_id, and to_trip_id will take precedence.

fields.name: transfers.from_trip_id
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Identifies a trip where a connection between routes begins. If from_trip_id is defined, the transfer will apply to the arriving trip for the given from_stop_id.

fields.name: transfers.to_trip_id
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Identifies a trip where a connection between routes ends. If to_trip_id is defined, the transfer will apply to the departing trip for the given to_stop_id.

fields.name: transfers.transfer_type
fields.description: (Required) Indicates the type of connection for the specified (from_stop_id, to_stop_id) pair. Valid options are: 0 or empty - Recommended transfer point between routes. 1 - Timed transfer point between two routes.

fields.name: transfers.min_transfer_time
fields.description: (Conditionally Required) Amount of time, in seconds, that must be available to permit a transfer between routes at the specified stops. The min_transfer_time should be sufficient to permit a typical rider to move between the two stops, including buffer time to allow for schedule variance on each…

fields.name: feed_info.feed_publisher_name
fields.description: (Required) Full name of the organization that publishes the dataset. This may be the same as one of the agency.agency_name values.

fields.name: feed_info.feed_publisher_url
fields.description: (Required) URL of the dataset publishing organization's website. This may be the same as one of the agency.agency_url values.

fields.name: feed_info.feed_lang
fields.description: (Required) Default language used for the text in this dataset. This setting helps GTFS consumers choose capitalization rules and other language-specific settings for the dataset. The file translations.txt can be used if the text needs to be translated into languages other than the default one.

fields.name: feed_info.default_lang
fields.description: (Optional) Defines the language that should be used when the data consumer doesn’t know the language of the rider. It will often be en (English).

fields.name: feed_info.feed_start_date
fields.description: (Recommended) The dataset provides complete and reliable schedule information for service in the period from the beginning of the feed_start_date day to the end of the feed_end_date day. Both days may be left empty if unavailable.

fields.name: feed_info.feed_end_date
fields.description: (Recommended) (see above)

fields.name: feed_info.feed_version
fields.description: (Recommended) String that indicates the current version of their GTFS dataset. GTFS-consuming applications can display this value to help dataset publishers determine whether the latest dataset has been incorporated.

fields.name: feed_info.feed_contact_email
fields.description: (Optional) Email address for communication regarding the GTFS dataset and data publishing practices. feed_contact_email is a technical contact for GTFS-consuming applications. Provide customer service contact information through agency.txt.

fields.name: feed_info.feed_contact_url
fields.description: (Optional) URL for contact information, a web-form, support desk, or other tools for communication regarding the GTFS dataset and data publishing practices. feed_contact_url is a technical contact for GTFS-consuming applications. Provide customer service contact information through agency.txt.

title: GTFS Realtime
recordDescription: Real-time transit updates as protocol buffer messages: trip updates/predictions, vehicle positions and service alerts tied to a GTFS Schedule feed.
updateFrequency: version gtfs-realtime.proto, feed spec version 2.0 (google/transit master @ 3c9e7b904b)

fields.name: FeedHeader.gtfs_realtime_version
fields.description: (required) Version of the feed specification. The current version is 2.0. Valid versions are "2.0", "1.0".

fields.name: FeedHeader.incrementality
fields.description: (optional) Determines whether the current fetch is incremental. Currently, DIFFERENTIAL mode is unsupported and behavior is unspecified for feeds that use this mode.

fields.name: FeedHeader.timestamp
fields.description: (optional) This timestamp identifies the moment when the content of this feed has been created (in server time). In POSIX time (i.e., number of seconds since January 1st 1970 00:00:00 UTC).

fields.name: FeedHeader.feed_version
fields.description: (optional) String that matches the feed_info.feed_version from the GTFS feed that the real time data is based on. Consumers can use this to identify which GTFS feed is currently active or when a new one is available to download.

fields.name: FeedEntity.id
fields.description: (required) The ids are used only to provide incrementality support. The id should be unique within a FeedMessage. Consequent FeedMessages may contain FeedEntities with the same id.

fields.name: FeedEntity.is_deleted
fields.description: (optional) Whether this entity is to be deleted. Relevant only for incremental fetches.

fields.name: FeedEntity.trip_update
fields.description: (optional) Data about the entity itself. Exactly one of the following fields must be present (unless the entity is being deleted).

fields.name: FeedEntity.vehicle
fields.description: (optional) Data about the entity itself. Exactly one of the following fields must be present (unless the entity is being deleted).

fields.name: FeedEntity.alert
fields.description: (optional) Data about the entity itself. Exactly one of the following fields must be present (unless the entity is being deleted).

fields.name: FeedEntity.shape
fields.description: (optional) NOTE: This field is still experimental, and subject to change. It may be formally adopted in the future.

fields.name: FeedEntity.stop
fields.description: (optional) NOTE: This field is still experimental, and subject to change. It may be formally adopted in the future.

fields.name: FeedEntity.trip_modifications
fields.description: (optional) NOTE: This field is still experimental, and subject to change. It may be formally adopted in the future.

fields.name: TripUpdate.trip
fields.description: (required) The Trip that this message applies to. There can be at most one TripUpdate entity for each actual trip instance. If there is none, that means there is no prediction information available. It does *not* mean that the trip is progressing according to schedule.

fields.name: TripUpdate.vehicle
fields.description: (optional) Additional information on the vehicle that is serving this trip.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeEvent.delay
fields.description: (optional) Delay (in seconds) can be positive (meaning that the vehicle is late) or negative (meaning that the vehicle is ahead of schedule). Delay of 0 means that the vehicle is exactly on time.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeEvent.time
fields.description: (optional) Event as absolute time. In Unix time (i.e., number of seconds since January 1st 1970 00:00:00 UTC).

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeEvent.uncertainty
fields.description: (optional) If uncertainty is omitted, it is interpreted as unknown. If the prediction is unknown or too uncertain, the delay (or time) field should be empty. In such case, the uncertainty field is ignored. To specify a completely certain prediction, set its uncertainty to 0.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeEvent.scheduled_time
fields.description: (optional) Scheduled time for a NEW, REPLACEMENT, or DUPLICATED trip. In Unix time (i.e., number of seconds since January 1st 1970 00:00:00 UTC). Optional if TripUpdate.schedule_relationship is NEW, REPLACEMENT or DUPLICATED, forbidden otherwise.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeUpdate.stop_sequence
fields.description: (optional) Must be the same as in stop_times.txt in the corresponding GTFS feed.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeUpdate.stop_id
fields.description: (optional) Must be the same as in stops.txt in the corresponding GTFS feed.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeUpdate.arrival
fields.description: (optional) Timing information for a single predicted event (either arrival or departure). Timing consists of delay and/or estimated time, and uncertainty. - delay should be used when the prediction is given relative to some existing schedule in GTFS.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeUpdate.departure
fields.description: (optional) Timing information for a single predicted event (either arrival or departure). Timing consists of delay and/or estimated time, and uncertainty. - delay should be used when the prediction is given relative to some existing schedule in GTFS.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeUpdate.departure_occupancy_status
fields.description: (optional) Expected occupancy after departure from the given stop. Should be provided only for future stops. In order to provide departure_occupancy_status without either arrival or departure StopTimeEvents, ScheduleRelationship should be set to NO_DATA.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeUpdate.schedule_relationship
fields.description: (optional) The relation between the StopTimeEvents and the static schedule.

fields.name: TripUpdate.StopTimeUpdate.stop_time_properties
fields.description: (optional) Realtime updates for certain properties defined within GTFS stop_times.txt NOTE: This field is still experimental, and subject to change. It may be formally adopted in the future.

fields.name: TripUpdate.stop_time_update
fields.description: (repeated) Updates to StopTimes for the trip (both future, i.e., predictions, and in some cases, past ones, i.e., those that already happened). The updates must be sorted by stop_sequence, and apply for all the following stops of the trip up to the next specified one.

fields.name: TripUpdate.timestamp
fields.description: (optional) The most recent moment at which the vehicle's real-time progress was measured to estimate StopTimes in the future. When StopTimes in the past are provided, arrival/departure times may be earlier than this value.

fields.name: TripUpdate.delay
fields.description: (optional) The current schedule deviation for the trip. Delay should only be specified when the prediction is given relative to some existing schedule in GTFS. Delay (in seconds) can be positive (meaning that the vehicle is late) or negative (meaning that the vehicle is ahead of schedule).

fields.name: TripUpdate.trip_properties
fields.description: (optional) Defines updated properties of the trip, such as a new shape_id when there is a detour. Or defines the trip_id, start_date, and start_time of a DUPLICATED trip. NOTE: This message is still experimental, and subject to change. It may be formally adopted in the future.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.trip
fields.description: (optional) The Trip that this vehicle is serving. Can be empty or partial if the vehicle can not be identified with a given trip instance.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.vehicle
fields.description: (optional) Additional information on the vehicle that is serving this trip.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.position
fields.description: (optional) Current position of this vehicle.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.current_stop_sequence
fields.description: (optional) The stop sequence index of the current stop. The meaning of current_stop_sequence (i.e., the stop that it refers to) is determined by current_status. If current_status is missing IN_TRANSIT_TO is assumed.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.stop_id
fields.description: (optional) Identifies the current stop. The value must be the same as in stops.txt in the corresponding GTFS feed.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.current_status
fields.description: (optional) The exact status of the vehicle with respect to the current stop. Ignored if current_stop_sequence is missing.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.timestamp
fields.description: (optional) Moment at which the vehicle's position was measured. In POSIX time (i.e., number of seconds since January 1st 1970 00:00:00 UTC).

fields.name: VehiclePosition.congestion_level
fields.description: (optional) Congestion level that is affecting this vehicle.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.occupancy_status
fields.description: (optional) If multi_carriage_status is populated with per-carriage OccupancyStatus, then this field should describe the entire vehicle with all carriages accepting passengers considered.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.occupancy_percentage
fields.description: (optional) A percentage value indicating the degree of passenger occupancy in the vehicle. The values are represented as an integer without decimals. 0 means 0% and 100 means 100%.

fields.name: VehiclePosition.multi_carriage_details
fields.description: (repeated) Details of the multiple carriages of this given vehicle. The first occurrence represents the first carriage of the vehicle, given the current direction of travel. The number of occurrences of the multi_carriage_details field represents the number of carriages of the vehicle.

fields.name: Alert.active_period
fields.description: (repeated [deprecated]) Time when the alert should be shown to the user. If missing, the alert will be shown as long as it appears in the feed. If multiple ranges are given, the alert will be shown during all of them. Should not be used - for backwards-compatibility only.

fields.name: Alert.communication_period
fields.description: (repeated) Time when the alert should be shown to the user strictly for informative reasons. If missing, the consuming application can decide when it's appropriate to be shown. If multiple ranges are given, the alert will be shown during all of them.

fields.name: Alert.impact_period
fields.description: (repeated) Time when the services are affected by the alert. If communication_period is specified, every time interval in impact_period must be fully contained within at least one time interval of communication_period.

fields.name: Alert.informed_entity
fields.description: (repeated) Entities whose users we should notify of this alert.

fields.name: Alert.cause
fields.description: (optional) Cause of this alert. If cause_detail is included, then Cause must also be included.

fields.name: Alert.effect
fields.description: (optional) What is the effect of this problem on the affected entity. If effect_detail is included, then Effect must also be included.

fields.name: Alert.url
fields.description: (optional) The URL which provides additional information about the alert.

fields.name: Alert.header_text
fields.description: (optional) Alert header. Contains a short summary of the alert text as plain-text.

fields.name: Alert.description_text
fields.description: (optional) Full description for the alert as plain-text. The information in the description should add to the information of the header.

fields.name: Alert.tts_header_text
fields.description: (optional) Text for alert header to be used in text-to-speech implementations. This field is the text-to-speech version of header_text.

fields.name: Alert.tts_description_text
fields.description: (optional) Text for full description for the alert to be used in text-to-speech implementations. This field is the text-to-speech version of description_text.

fields.name: Alert.severity_level
fields.description: (optional) Severity of this alert.

fields.name: Alert.image
fields.description: (optional) TranslatedImage to be displayed along the alert text. Used to explain visually the alert effect of a detour, station closure, etc. The image must enhance the understanding of the alert. Any essential information communicated within the image must also be contained in the alert text.

fields.name: Alert.image_alternative_text
fields.description: (optional) Text describing the appearance of the linked image in the image field (e.g., in case the image can't be displayed or the user can't see the image for accessibility reasons). See the HTML spec for alt image text - https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#alt.

fields.name: Alert.cause_detail
fields.description: (optional) Description of the cause of the alert that allows for agency-specific language; more specific than the Cause. If cause_detail is included, then Cause must also be included. NOTE: This field is still experimental, and subject to change. It may be formally adopted in the future.

fields.name: Alert.effect_detail
fields.description: (optional) Description of the effect of the alert that allows for agency-specific language; more specific than the Effect. If effect_detail is included, then Effect must also be included. NOTE: This field is still experimental, and subject to change. It may be formally adopted in the future.

fields.name: Position.latitude
fields.description: (required) Degrees North, in the WGS-84 coordinate system.

fields.name: Position.longitude
fields.description: (required) Degrees East, in the WGS-84 coordinate system.

fields.name: Position.bearing
fields.description: (optional) Bearing, in degrees, clockwise from North, i.e., 0 is North and 90 is East. This can be the compass bearing, or the direction towards the next stop or intermediate location.

fields.name: Position.odometer
fields.description: (optional) Odometer value, in meters.

fields.name: Position.speed
fields.description: (optional) Momentary speed measured by the vehicle, in meters per second.

fields.name: TripDescriptor.trip_id
fields.description: (optional) The trip_id from the GTFS feed that this selector refers to. For non frequency-based trips, this field is enough to uniquely identify the trip. For frequency-based trip, start_time and start_date might also be necessary.

fields.name: TripDescriptor.route_id
fields.description: (optional) The route_id from the GTFS that this selector refers to.

fields.name: TripDescriptor.direction_id
fields.description: (optional) The direction_id from the GTFS feed trips.txt file, indicating the direction of travel for trips this selector refers to.

fields.name: TripDescriptor.start_time
fields.description: (optional) The initially scheduled start time of this trip instance. When the trip_id corresponds to a non-frequency-based trip, this field should either be omitted or be equal to the value in the GTFS feed.

fields.name: TripDescriptor.start_date
fields.description: (optional) The scheduled start date of this trip instance. Must be provided to disambiguate trips that are so late as to collide with a scheduled trip on a next day.

fields.name: TripDescriptor.schedule_relationship
fields.description: (optional) The relation between this trip and the static schedule. If a trip is done in accordance with temporary schedule, not reflected in GTFS, then it shouldn't be marked as SCHEDULED, but likely as ADDED.

fields.name: TripDescriptor.modified_trip
fields.description: (optional) Linkage to any modifications done to this trip (shape changes, removal or addition of stops). If this field is provided, the trip_id, route_id, direction_id, start_time, start_date fields of the TripDescriptor MUST be left empty, to avoid confusion by consumers that aren't looking for…

fields.name: VehicleDescriptor.id
fields.description: (optional) Internal system identification of the vehicle. Should be unique per vehicle, and can be used for tracking the vehicle as it proceeds through the system.

fields.name: VehicleDescriptor.label
fields.description: (optional) User visible label, i.e., something that must be shown to the passenger to help identify the correct vehicle.

fields.name: VehicleDescriptor.license_plate
fields.description: (optional) The license plate of the vehicle.

fields.name: VehicleDescriptor.wheelchair_accessible
fields.description: (optional)

title: General Bikeshare Feed Specification (GBFS)
recordDescription: Real-time shared-mobility (bike, scooter, car share) system information: system metadata, vehicle types, stations and their status, free-floating vehicles, and pricing plans.
license: Specification text: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (stated in gbfs.md 'License' section)
updateFrequency: version v3.0 (latest non-prerelease release, tag v3.0 @ 457cb71121; master is at v3.1-RC3)

fields.name: system_information.system_id
fields.description: (Required: Yes) This is a globally unique identifier for the vehicle share system. Each distinct system or geographic area in which vehicles are operated MUST have its own unique system_id.

fields.name: system_information.languages
fields.description: (Required: Yes) List of languages used in translated strings.

fields.name: system_information.name
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Name of the system to be displayed to customers.

fields.name: system_information.opening_hours
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Hours and dates of operation for the system in OSM opening_hours format. *(added in v3.0)*

fields.name: system_information.short_name
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Abbreviation for a system.

fields.name: system_information.operator
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Name of the system operator.

fields.name: system_information.url
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The URL of the vehicle share system.

fields.name: system_information.purchase_url
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) URL where a customer can purchase a membership.

fields.name: system_information.start_date
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Date that the system began operations.

fields.name: system_information.termination_date
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Date after which this data source will no longer be available to consuming applications. This OPTIONAL field SHOULD be used to notify 3rd party data consumers when a service is planning a permanent (non-seasonal) shutdown.

fields.name: system_information.phone_number
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) This OPTIONAL field SHOULD contain a single voice telephone number for the specified system’s customer service department. MUST be in E.164 format as defined in Field Types.

fields.name: system_information.email
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) This OPTIONAL field SHOULD contain a single contact email address actively monitored by the operator’s customer service department. This email address SHOULD be a direct contact point where riders can reach a customer service representative.

fields.name: system_information.feed_contact_email
fields.description: (Required: Yes *(as of v3.0)*) This field MUST contain a single contact email for feed consumers to report issues with the feed. This email address SHOULD point to a stable email address, that does not correspond to an individual but rather the team or company that manages GBFS feeds.

fields.name: system_information.manifest_url
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED) REQUIRED if the producer publishes datasets for more than one system geography, for example Berlin and Paris. A fully qualified URL pointing to the manifest.json file for the publisher.

fields.name: system_information.timezone
fields.description: (Required: Yes) The time zone where the system is located.

fields.name: system_information.license_id
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED) REQUIRED if the dataset is provided under a standard license. An identifier for a standard license from the SPDX License List. Provide license_id rather than license_url if the license is included in the SPDX License List.

fields.name: system_information.license_url
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED *(as of v3.0)*) REQUIRED if the dataset is provided under a customized license. A fully qualified URL of a page that defines the license terms for the GBFS data for this system. Do not specify a license_url if license_id is specified.

fields.name: system_information.attribution_organization_name
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) If the feed license requires attribution, name of the organization to which attribution should be provided.

fields.name: system_information.attribution_url
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) URL of the organization to which attribution should be provided.

fields.name: system_information.brand_assets
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Object containing branding information about the system.

fields.name: system_information.terms_url
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) A fully qualified URL pointing to the terms of service (also often called "terms of use" or "terms and conditions") for the service.

fields.name: system_information.terms_last_updated
fields.description: (Required: REQUIRED) The date that the terms of service provided at terms_url were last updated.

fields.name: system_information.privacy_url
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) A fully qualified URL pointing to the privacy policy for the service.

fields.name: system_information.privacy_last_updated
fields.description: (Required: REQUIRED) The date that the privacy policy provided at privacy_url was last updated.

fields.name: system_information.rental_apps
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Contains rental app information in the android and ios JSON objects.

fields.name: vehicle_types.vehicle_type_id
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Unique identifier of a vehicle type. See Field Types above for ID field requirements.

fields.name: vehicle_types.form_factor
fields.description: (Required: Yes) The vehicle's general form factor. Current valid values are: bicycle cargo_bicycle *(added in v2.3)* car moped scooter_standing *(standing kick scooter, added in v2.3)* scooter_seated *(this is a kick scooter with a seat, not to be confused with moped, added in v2.3)* other

fields.name: vehicle_types.rider_capacity
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The number of riders (driver included) the vehicle can legally accommodate.

fields.name: vehicle_types.cargo_volume_capacity
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Cargo volume available in the vehicle, expressed in liters. For cars, it corresponds to the space between the boot floor, including the storage under the hatch, to the rear shelf in the trunk.

fields.name: vehicle_types.cargo_load_capacity
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The capacity of the vehicle cargo space (excluding passengers), expressed in kilograms.

fields.name: vehicle_types.propulsion_type
fields.description: (Required: Yes) The primary propulsion type of the vehicle. Current valid values are: human _(Pedal or foot propulsion)_ electric_assist _(Provides electric motor assist only in combination with human propulsion - no throttle mode)_ electric _(Powered by battery-powered electric motor with…

fields.name: vehicle_types.eco_labels
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Vehicle air quality certificate. Official anti-pollution certificate, based on the information on the vehicle's registration certificate, attesting to its level of pollutant emissions based on a defined standard. In Europe, for example, it is the European emission standard.

fields.name: vehicle_types.max_range_meters
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED) If the vehicle has a motor (as indicated by having a value other than human in the propulsion_type field), this field is REQUIRED.

fields.name: vehicle_types.name
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The public name of this vehicle type.

fields.name: vehicle_types.vehicle_accessories
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Description of accessories available in the vehicle. These accessories are part of the vehicle and are not supposed to change frequently.

fields.name: vehicle_types.g_CO2_km
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Maximum quantity of CO2, in grams, emitted per kilometer, according to the WLTP.

fields.name: vehicle_types.vehicle_image
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) URL to an image that would assist the user in identifying the vehicle (for example, an image of the vehicle or a logo). Allowed formats: JPEG, PNG.

fields.name: vehicle_types.make
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The name of the vehicle manufacturer. Example: CUBE Bikes Renault

fields.name: vehicle_types.model
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The name of the vehicle model. Example Giulia MX50

fields.name: vehicle_types.color
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The color of the vehicle. All words must be in lower case, without special characters, quotation marks, hyphens, underscores, commas, or dots. Spaces are allowed in case of a compound name. Example green dark blue

fields.name: vehicle_types.description
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Customer-readable description of the vehicle type outlining special features or how-tos.

fields.name: vehicle_types.wheel_count
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Number of wheels this vehicle type has.

fields.name: vehicle_types.max_permitted_speed
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The maximum speed in kilometers per hour this vehicle is permitted to reach in accordance with local permit and regulations.

fields.name: vehicle_types.rated_power
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The rated power of the motor for this vehicle type in watts.

fields.name: vehicle_types.default_reserve_time
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Maximum time in minutes that a vehicle can be reserved before a rental begins. When a vehicle is reserved by a user, the vehicle remains locked until the rental begins. During this time the vehicle is unavailable and cannot be reserved or rented by other users.

fields.name: vehicle_types.return_constraint
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The conditions for returning the vehicle at the end of the rental. Current valid values are: free_floating _(The vehicle can be returned anywhere permitted within the service area.

fields.name: vehicle_types.vehicle_assets
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Object containing the branding information for this vehicle type.

fields.name: vehicle_types.default_pricing_plan_id
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED) REQUIRED if system_pricing_plans.json is defined. A plan_id, as defined in system_pricing_plans.json, that identifies a default pricing plan for this vehicle to be used by trip planning applications for purposes of calculating the cost of a single trip using this…

fields.name: vehicle_types.pricing_plan_ids
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) An array of pricing_plan_ids, as defined in system_pricing_plans.json, that are applied to this vehicle type. This array SHOULD be published when there are multiple pricing plans defined in system_pricing_plans.json that apply to a single vehicle type.

fields.name: station_information.station_id
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Identifier of a station.

fields.name: station_information.name
fields.description: (Required: Yes) The public name of the station for display in maps, digital signage, and other text applications. Names SHOULD reflect the station location through the use of a cross street or local landmark.

fields.name: station_information.short_name
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Short name or other type of identifier.

fields.name: station_information.lat
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Latitude of the station in decimal degrees. This field SHOULD have a precision of 6 decimal places (0.000001). See Coordinate Precision.

fields.name: station_information.lon
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Longitude of the station in decimal degrees. This field SHOULD have a precision of 6 decimal places (0.000001). See Coordinate Precision.

fields.name: station_information.address
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Address (street number and name) where station is located. This MUST be a valid address, not a free-form text description. Example: 1234 Main Street

fields.name: station_information.cross_street
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Cross street or landmark where the station is located.

fields.name: station_information.region_id
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Identifier of the region where station is located. See system_regions.json.

fields.name: station_information.post_code
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Postal code where station is located.

fields.name: station_information.station_opening_hours
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Hours of operation for the station in OSM opening_hours format. If station_opening_hours is defined it overrides any opening_hours defined in system_information.json for the station for which it is defined.

fields.name: station_information.rental_methods
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Payment methods accepted at this station. Current valid values are: key (operator issued vehicle key / fob / card) creditcard paypass applepay androidpay transitcard accountnumber phone

fields.name: station_information.is_virtual_station
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Is this station a location with or without smart dock technology? true - The station is a location without smart docking infrastructure. the station may be defined by a point (lat/lon) and/or station_area (below).

fields.name: station_information.station_area
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) A GeoJSON MultiPolygon that describes the area of a virtual station. If station_area is supplied, then the record describes a virtual station.

fields.name: station_information.parking_type
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Type of parking station. Current valid values are: parking_lot _(Off-street parking lot)_ street_parking _(Curbside parking)_ underground_parking _(Parking that is below street level, station may be non-communicating)_ sidewalk_parking _(Park vehicle on sidewalk, out of the…

fields.name: station_information.parking_hoop
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Are parking hoops present at this station? true - Parking hoops are present at this station. false - Parking hoops are not present at this station. Parking hoops are lockable devices that are used to secure a parking space to prevent parking of unauthorized vehicles.

fields.name: station_information.contact_phone
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Contact phone of the station.

fields.name: station_information.capacity
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Number of total docking points installed at this station, both available and unavailable, regardless of what vehicle types are allowed at each dock.

fields.name: station_information.vehicle_types_capacity
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) These objects are used to model the parking capacity of virtual stations (defined using the is_virtual_station field) for each vehicle type that can be returned to this station.

fields.name: station_information.vehicle_docks_capacity
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) These objects are used to model the total docking capacity of a station, both available and unavailable, for each type of vehicle that may dock at this station. The total number of docks from each of these objects SHOULD add up to match the value specified in the capacity field.

fields.name: station_information.is_valet_station
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Are valet services provided at this station? true - Valet services are provided at this station. false - Valet services are not provided at this station. If this field is empty, it is assumed that valet services are not provided at this station.

fields.name: station_information.is_charging_station
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Does the station support charging of electric vehicles? true - Electric vehicle charging is available at this station. false - Electric vehicle charging is not available at this station.

fields.name: station_information.rental_uris
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Contains rental URIs for Android, iOS, and web in the android, ios, and web fields. See examples of how to use these fields and supported analytics.

fields.name: station_status.station_id
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Identifier of a station. See station_information.json.

fields.name: station_status.num_vehicles_available
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Number of functional vehicles physically at the station that may be offered for rental. To know if the vehicles are available for rental, see is_renting. If is_renting = true this is the number of vehicles that are currently available for rent.

fields.name: station_status.vehicle_types_available
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED) REQUIRED if the vehicle_types.json file has been defined. This field's value is an array of objects. Each of these objects is used to model the total number of each defined vehicle type available at a station.

fields.name: station_status.num_vehicles_disabled
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Number of disabled vehicles of any type at the station. Vendors who do not want to publicize the number of disabled vehicles or docks in their system can opt to omit station capacity (in station_information.json, num_vehicles_disabled, and num_docks_disabled *(as of v2.0)*.

fields.name: station_status.num_docks_available
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED *(as of v2.0)*) REQUIRED except for stations that have unlimited docking capacity (e.g. virtual stations) *(as of v2.0)*. Number of functional docks physically at the station that are able to accept vehicles for return.

fields.name: station_status.vehicle_docks_available
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED) This field is REQUIRED in feeds where the vehicle_types.json is defined and where certain docks are only able to accept certain vehicle types. If every dock at the station is able to accept any vehicle type, then this field is not REQUIRED.

fields.name: station_status.num_docks_disabled
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Number of disabled dock points at the station.

fields.name: station_status.is_installed
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Is the station currently on the street? true - Station is installed on the street. false - Station is not installed on the street. Boolean SHOULD be set to true when equipment is present on the street.

fields.name: station_status.is_renting
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Is the station currently renting vehicles? true - Station is renting vehicles. Even if the station is empty, if it would otherwise allow rentals, this value MUST be true. false - Station is not renting vehicles.

fields.name: station_status.is_returning
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Is the station accepting vehicle returns? true - Station is accepting vehicle returns. Even if the station is full, if it would otherwise allow vehicle returns, this value MUST be true. false - Station is not accepting vehicle returns.

fields.name: station_status.last_reported
fields.description: (Required: Yes) The last time this station reported its status to the operator's backend.

fields.name: vehicle_status.vehicle_id
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Identifier of a vehicle. The vehicle_id identifier MUST be rotated to a random string after each trip to protect user privacy *(as of v2.0)*. Use of persistent vehicle IDs poses a threat to user privacy. The vehicle_id identifier SHOULD only be rotated once per trip.

fields.name: vehicle_status.lat
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED *(as of v2.1)*) Latitude of the vehicle in decimal degrees. *(as of v2.1)* REQUIRED if station_id is not provided for this vehicle (free floating). This field SHOULD have a precision of 6 decimal places (0.000001). See Coordinate Precision.

fields.name: vehicle_status.lon
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED *(as of v2.1)*) Longitude of the vehicle in decimal degrees. *(as of v2.1)* REQUIRED if station_id is not provided for this vehicle (free floating). This field SHOULD have a precision of 6 decimal places (0.000001). See Coordinate Precision.

fields.name: vehicle_status.is_reserved
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Is the vehicle currently reserved? true - Vehicle is currently reserved. false - Vehicle is not currently reserved.

fields.name: vehicle_status.is_disabled
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Is the vehicle currently disabled? true - Vehicle is currently disabled. false - Vehicle is not currently disabled. This field is used to indicate vehicles that are in the field but not available for rental due to a mechanical issue or low battery etc.

fields.name: vehicle_status.rental_uris
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) JSON object that contains rental URIs for Android, iOS, and web in the android, ios, and web fields. See examples of how to use these fields and supported analytics.

fields.name: vehicle_status.vehicle_type_id
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED) The vehicle_type_id of this vehicle, as described in vehicle_types.json. REQUIRED if the vehicle_types.json file is defined.

fields.name: vehicle_status.last_reported
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The last time this vehicle reported its status to the operator's backend.

fields.name: vehicle_status.current_range_meters
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED) REQUIRED if the corresponding vehicle_type definition for this vehicle has a motor. This value represents the furthest distance in meters that the vehicle can travel with the vehicle's current charge or fuel (without recharging or refueling).

fields.name: vehicle_status.current_fuel_percent
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) This value represents the current percentage, expressed from 0 to 1, of fuel or battery power remaining in the vehicle.

fields.name: vehicle_status.station_id
fields.description: (Required: Conditionally REQUIRED) REQUIRED if the vehicle is currently at a station and the vehicle_types.json file has been defined. Identifier referencing the station_id field in station_information.json.

fields.name: vehicle_status.home_station_id
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The station_id of the station this vehicle must be returned to as defined in station_information.json.

fields.name: vehicle_status.pricing_plan_id
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The plan_id of the pricing plan this vehicle is eligible for as described in system_pricing_plans.json. If this field is defined it supersedes default_pricing_plan_id in vehicle_types.json.

fields.name: vehicle_status.vehicle_equipment
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) List of vehicle equipment provided by the operator in addition to the accessories already provided in the vehicle (field vehicle_accessories of vehicle_types.json) but subject to more frequent updates.

fields.name: vehicle_status.available_until
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) The date and time when any rental of the vehicle must be completed. The vehicle must be returned and made available for the next user by this time. If this field is empty, it indicates that the vehicle is available indefinitely.

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.plan_id
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Identifier for a pricing plan in the system.

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.url
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) URL where the customer can learn more about this pricing plan.

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.name
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Name of this pricing plan.

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.currency
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Currency used to pay the fare. This pricing is in ISO 4217 code: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217 (for example, CAD for Canadian dollars, EUR for euros, or JPY for Japanese yen.)

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.price
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Fare price, in the unit specified by currency. *(added in v2.2)* In case of non-rate price, this field is the total price. In case of rate price, this field is the base price that is charged only once per trip (typically the price for unlocking) in addition to per_km_pricing and/or…

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.is_taxable
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Will additional tax be added to the base price? true - Yes. false - No. false MAY be used to indicate that tax is not charged or that tax is included in the base price.

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.description
fields.description: (Required: Yes) Customer-readable description of the pricing plan. This SHOULD include the duration, price, conditions, etc. that the publisher would like users to see.

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.per_km_pricing
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Array of segments when the price is a function of distance traveled, displayed in kilometers. Total cost is the addition of price and all segments in per_km_pricing and per_min_pricing. If this array is not provided, there are no variable costs based on distance.

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.per_min_pricing
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Array of segments when the price is a function of time traveled, displayed in minutes. Total cost is the addition of price and all segments in per_km_pricing and per_min_pricing. If this array is not provided, there are no variable costs based on time.

fields.name: system_pricing_plans.surge_pricing
fields.description: (Required: OPTIONAL) Is there currently an increase in price in response to increased demand in this pricing plan? If this field is empty, it means there is no surge pricing in effect. true - Surge pricing is in effect. false - Surge pricing is not in effect.

title: Open311 GeoReport v2
recordDescription: Non-emergency civic service request (311) API: the list of service types a jurisdiction accepts and the service requests filed against them, with status and location.
license: Not stated on the specification page
updateFrequency: version v2 (spec page says it is 'frozen and finalized')

fields.name: services.service_code
fields.description: The unique identifier for the service request type

fields.name: services.service_name
fields.description: The human readable name of the service request type

fields.name: services.description
fields.description: A brief description of the service request type.

fields.name: services.metadata
fields.description: Determines whether there are additional form fields for this service type. true : This service request type requires additional metadata so the client will need to make a call to the Service Definition method.

fields.name: services.type
fields.description: realtime : The service request ID will be returned immediately after the service request is submitted. batch : A token will be returned immediately after the service request is submitted. This token can then be later used to return the service request ID.

fields.name: services.keywords
fields.description: A comma separated list of tags or keywords to help users identify the request type. This can provide synonyms of the service_name and group.

fields.name: services.group
fields.description: A category to group this service type within. This provides a way to group several service request types under one category such as “sanitation”

fields.name: requests.service_request_id
fields.description: The unique ID of the service request created.

fields.name: requests.status
fields.description: The current status of the service request. open : it has been reported. closed : it has been resolved. Notes: Options: open , closed

fields.name: requests.status_notes
fields.description: Explanation of why status was changed to current state or more details on current status than conveyed with status alone. Notes: May not be returned

fields.name: requests.service_name
fields.description: The human readable name of the service request type

fields.name: requests.service_code
fields.description: The unique identifier for the service request type

fields.name: requests.description
fields.description: A full description of the request or report submitted. Notes: This may contain line breaks, but not html or code. Otherwise, this is free form text limited to 4,000 characters.

fields.name: requests.agency_responsible
fields.description: The agency responsible for fulfilling or otherwise addressing the service request. Notes: May not be returned

fields.name: requests.service_notice
fields.description: Information about the action expected to fulfill the request or otherwise address the information reported. Notes: May not be returned

fields.name: requests.requested_datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the service request was made. Notes: Returned in w3 format, eg 2010-01-01T00:00:00Z

fields.name: requests.updated_datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the service request was last modified. For requests with status=closed, this will be the date the request was closed. Notes: Returned in w3 format, eg 2010-01-01T00:00:00Z

fields.name: requests.expected_datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the service request can be expected to be fulfilled. This may be based on a service-specific service level agreement. Notes: May not be returned

fields.name: requests.address
fields.description: Human readable address or description of location. Notes: This should be provided from most specific to most general geographic unit, eg address number or cross streets, street name, neighborhood/district, city/town/village, county, postal code.

fields.name: requests.address_id
fields.description: The internal address ID used by a jurisdictions master address repository or other addressing system.

fields.name: requests.zipcode
fields.description: The postal code for the location of the service request.

fields.name: requests.lat
fields.description: latitude using the (WGS84) projection.

fields.name: requests.long
fields.description: longitude using the (WGS84) projection.

fields.name: requests.media_url
fields.description: A URL to media associated with the request, eg an image. Notes: A convention for parsing media from this URL has yet to be established, so currently it will be done on a case by case basis much like Twitter.com does.

fields.name: Thing.name
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) A property provides a label for Thing entity, commonly a descriptive name.

fields.name: Thing.description
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) This is a short description of the corresponding Thing entity.

fields.name: Thing.properties
fields.description: (Zero-to-one) A JSON Object containing user-annotated properties as key-value pairs.

fields.name: Location.id
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) id is the system-generated identifier of an entity. id is unique among the entities of the same entity type in a SensorThings service. Encoded in JSON as @iot.id (per Table 2 common control information and the spec's JSON examples).

fields.name: Location.name

fields.name: Location.description

fields.name: Location.properties

fields.name: HistoricalLocation.time
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) The time when the Thing is known at the Location.

fields.name: HistoricalLocation.Thing
fields.description: (Relation: Many optional to one mandatory) A HistoricalLocation has one-and-only-one Thing. One Thing MAY have zero-to-many HistoricalLocations.

fields.name: Datastream.id
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) id is the system-generated identifier of an entity. id is unique among the entities of the same entity type in a SensorThings service. Encoded in JSON as @iot.id (per Table 2 common control information and the spec's JSON examples).

fields.name: Datastream.name
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) A property provides a label for Datastream entity, commonly a descriptive name.

fields.name: Datastream.description
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) The description of the Datastream entity.

fields.name: Datastream.unitOfMeasurement
fields.description: (One (mandatory) Note: When a Datastream does not have a unit of measurement (e.g., a OM_TruthObservation type), the corresponding unitOfMeasurement properties SHALL have null values.) A JSON Object containing three key-value pairs.

fields.name: Datastream.observationType
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) The type of Observation (with unique result type), which is used by the service to encode observations.

fields.name: Datastream.properties
fields.description: (Zero-to-one) A JSON Object containing user-annotated properties as key-value pairs.

fields.name: Datastream.observedArea
fields.description: (Zero-to-one (optional)) The spatial bounding box of the spatial extent of all FeaturesOfInterest that belong to the Observations associated with this Datastream.

fields.name: Datastream.phenomenonTime
fields.description: (Zero-to-one (optional)) The temporal interval of the phenomenon times of all observations belonging to this Datastream.

fields.name: Datastream.resultTime
fields.description: (Zero-to-one (optional)) The temporal interval of the result times of all observations belonging to this Datastream.

fields.name: Datastream.Thing

fields.description: (Relation: Many optional to one mandatory) The Observations in a Datastream are performed by one-and-only-one Sensor. One Sensor MAY produce zero-to-many Observations in different Datastreams.

fields.name: Datastream.ObservedProperty
fields.description: (Relation: Many optional to one mandatory) The Observations of a Datastream SHALL observe the same ObservedProperty. The Observations of different Datastreams MAY observe the same ObservedProperty.

fields.name: Sensor.id

fields.name: Sensor.description

fields.name: Sensor.encodingType

fields.name: Sensor.metadata
fields.description: Depending on the value of the encodingType. (One (mandatory)) The detailed description of the Sensor or system. The metadata type is defined by encodingType.

fields.name: Sensor.properties

fields.name: ObservedProperty.definition
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) The URI of the ObservedProperty. Dereferencing this URI SHOULD result in a representation of the definition of the ObservedProperty.

fields.name: ObservedProperty.description
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) A description about the ObservedProperty.

fields.name: ObservedProperty.properties
fields.description: (Zero-to-one) A JSON Object containing user-annotated properties as key-value pairs.

fields.name: Observation.id

fields.name: Observation.phenomenonTime
fields.description: ISO 8601 Time string or Time Interval string (e.g., 2010-12-23T10:20:00.00-07:00 or 2010-12-23T10:20:00.00-07:00/2010-12-23T12:20:00.00-07:00 ). (One (mandatory)) The time instant or period of when the Observation happens. Note: Many resource-constrained sensing devices do not have a clock. fields.name: Observation.result
fields.description: Depends on the observationType defined in the associated Datastream. (One (mandatory)) The estimated value of an ObservedProperty from the Observation.

fields.name: Observation.resultQuality
fields.description: (Zero-to-many) Describes the quality of the result.

fields.name: Observation.parameters

fields.name: Observation.FeatureOfInterest
fields.description: (Relation: Many optional to one mandatory) An Observation observes on one-and-only-one FeatureOfInterest. One FeatureOfInterest could be observed by zero-to-many Observations.

fields.name: FeatureOfInterest.id

fields.name: FeatureOfInterest.name
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) A property provides a label for FeatureOfInterest entity, commonly a descriptive name.

fields.name: FeatureOfInterest.description
