fields.name: FeatureOfInterest.encodingType
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) The encoding type of the feature property. Its value is one of the ValueCode enumeration (see Table 7 for the available ValueCode).

fields.name: FeatureOfInterest.feature
fields.description: (One (mandatory)) The detailed description of the feature. The data type is defined by encodingType.

fields.name: FeatureOfInterest.properties

title: MMUCC Guideline: Model Minimum Uniform Crash Criteria, 6th Edition
publisher: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), U.S. DOT
recordDescription: Recommended minimum set of data elements, with definitions and attribute values, that States should collect on police-reported motor vehicle traffic crashes at the crash, vehicle, driver, person and non-motorist levels.
license: U.S. Government publication; distribution statement: 'Document is available to the public from the DOT, National Highway

fields.name: S1 State Unique Crash ID
fields.description: No selection rule stated. The unique crash report identifier (also referred to as the State case number) maintained in the statewide crash data repository.

fields.name: S2 Agency (Police Jurisdiction)
fields.description: No selection rule stated. Law enforcement agency reporting the crash.

fields.name: S3 Police-Reported
fields.description: No selection rule stated. Indicates whether this is a crash report completed and signed by a law enforcement officer or representative appointed by the law enforcement agency (e.g., a non-sworn officer).

fields.name: S4 State Reportable Crash
fields.description: No selection rule stated. Indicates whether a crash meets the State’s threshold for a reportable crash and is required to be reported by State law.

fields.name: C1 Crash Date
fields.description: The date when the crash occurred or if unknown, the date the crash was reported.

fields.name: C2 Crash Time
fields.description: The time at which the crash occurred.

fields.name: C3 Date of Roadway Clearance
fields.description: The date of first recordable awareness to when all traffic lanes became available for normal traffic flow.

fields.name: C4 Time of Roadway Clearance
fields.description: The time of first recordable awareness to when all traffic lanes became available for normal traffic flow.

fields.name: C5 County or Equivalent
fields.description: The county or equivalent entity in which the crash physically occurred.

fields.name: C6 Global Position (Latitude, Longitude)
fields.description: The latitude and longitude where the FIRST HARMFUL EVENT of the crash occurred.

fields.name: C7 First Harmful Event
fields.description: The first injury- or damage-producing event of the crash.

fields.name: C8 Location of First Harmful Event Relative to the Trafficway
fields.description: The location of the FIRST HARMFUL EVENT as it relates to its position within or outside the trafficway.

fields.name: C9 Manner of Collision of the First Harmful Event
fields.description: Identifies the orientation of two Motor Vehicles In-Transport when they are involved in the FIRST HARMFUL EVENT of a collision crash. If the FIRST HARMFUL EVENT is not a collision between two motor vehicles in-transport, it is classified as such.

fields.name: C10 Atmospheric Conditions
fields.description: The prevailing atmospheric conditions that existed at the time of the crash.

fields.name: C11 Light Condition
fields.description: The type or level of light that existed at the time of the motor vehicle traffic crash.

fields.name: C12 Relation to Junction
fields.description: The location of the FIRST HARMFUL EVENT with respect to presence in a junction or proximity to components typically in junction or interchange areas. Subfields: Within Interchange Area (select one); Specific Location (select one).

fields.name: C13 Type of Intersection
fields.description: Allows separation of various intersection types when the location of the FIRST HARMFUL EVENT is in an intersection or related to the use of an intersection.

fields.name: C14 School-Bus-Related
fields.description: Indicates whether a school bus or motor vehicle functioning as a school bus for a school-related purpose is directly or indirectly involved in the crash.

fields.name: C15 Work Zone
fields.description: A crash that occurs in or related to a construction, maintenance, or utility work zone, whether workers were present at the time of the crash or not. Subfields: Work Zone Type (select one); Location of the Crash (select one); Work Zone Description (This is a multi-selection Subfield.

fields.name: C16 Secondary Crash
fields.description: Identifies if this crash was related to a prior (primary) crash. Subfields: Secondary Crash (select one); Primary Crash Case Number (Specify).

fields.name: C17 Related Factors – Crash Level
fields.description: Identifies factors related to this crash.

fields.name: C18 Route Number or Road Name
fields.description: The signed route number or road name for the road on which the crash occurred.

fields.name: V1 Motor Vehicle Number
fields.description: Motor vehicle number assigned to uniquely identify each motor vehicle involved in the crash.

fields.name: V2 Vehicle Identification Number
fields.description: A unique combination of 17 alphanumeric characters assigned to a specific motor vehicle designated by the manufacturer.

fields.name: V3 Motor Vehicle Unit Type
fields.description: The type of unit that applies to this motor vehicle at the time it became an involved vehicle in the crash.

fields.name: V4 Vehicle Owner and Address
fields.description: The name and address of the owner of this vehicle. Subfields: Name or Entity (Specify); Address (Specify).

fields.name: V5 Motor Carrier or Responsible Entity Identification
fields.description: The identification number (or numbers) of the business entity, individual, partnership, corporation, or organization responsible for the transportation of people or property. Subfields: U.S.

fields.name: V6 Type of Motor Carrier or Responsible Entity
fields.description: The type of business entity, individual, partnership, corporation, or organization responsible for the transportation of people or property.

fields.name: V7 Motor Carrier or Responsible Entity Name and Address
fields.description: The name and address of the business entity, individual, partnership, corporation, or organization responsible for the transportation of people or property. Subfields: Motor Carrier or Responsible Entity Name (Specify); Motor Carrier or Responsible Entity Address (Specify).

fields.name: V8 Motor Vehicle Registration State or Country
fields.description: The State, commonwealth, territory, Indian Nation, U.S. Government, foreign country, etc., issuing the license plate displayed on the motor vehicle.

fields.name: V9 Motor Vehicle License Plate Number
fields.description: The alphanumeric identifier or other characters, exactly as displayed, on the license plate or tag affixed to the motor vehicle.

fields.name: V10 Motor Vehicle Make
fields.description: The manufacturer-assigned name applied to a group of motor vehicles.

fields.name: V11 Motor Vehicle Model Year
fields.description: The year assigned to a motor vehicle by the manufacturer.

fields.name: V12 Motor Vehicle Model
fields.description: The manufacturer-assigned name denoting a family of motor vehicles within a make that have a degree of similarity in construction, such as body, chassis, etc.

fields.name: V13 Motor Vehicle Body Type Category
fields.description: The category indicating the general configuration or shape of a motor vehicle distinguished by characteristics such as number of doors, rows of seats, windows, or roof line. Subfields: Body Type Category (select one); Number of Seats, including driver (applicable only for Body Types in Group 2.

fields.name: V14 Power Unit Gross Vehicle Weight Rating
fields.description: The value specified by the manufacturer as the recommended maximum loaded weight of a single motor vehicle.

fields.name: V15 Cargo Body Type (Power Unit Only)
fields.description: The primary cargo-carrying capability of this vehicle.

fields.name: V16 Hazardous Materials
fields.description: Indication of the hazardous materials identification and class being transported by the motor vehicle, and whether hazardous materials were released. Subfields: Hazardous Materials Present (select one); Placard (select one); 4-Digit Hazardous Materials Identification Number (Specify); Hazardous…

fields.name: V17 Vehicle Trailing
fields.description: Identifies whether this vehicle had any attached trailing units or was towing another motor vehicle.

fields.name: V18 Trailer VIN
fields.description: A unique combination of alphanumeric characters assigned to each trailer designated by the manufacturer. Subfields: First Trailer (Select or Specify 1); Second Trailer (Select or Specify 1); Third Trailer (Select or Specify 1).

fields.name: V19 Trailer Body Type
fields.description: The primary cargo carrying capability of this trailer. Subfields: First Trailer (select one); Second Trailer (select one); Third Trailer (select one).

fields.name: V20 Total Occupants in Motor Vehicle
fields.description: The total number of injured and uninjured occupants in this motor vehicle involved in the crash, including people in or on the motor vehicle at the time of the crash.

fields.name: V21 Special Use
fields.description: The type of authorized special use being served by this motor vehicle regardless of whether the use is marked on the vehicle or aligns to the body type, at the time of the crash. For example, a 15-Passenger van being used as a school bus.

fields.name: V22 Bus Use
fields.description: The common type of bus service this vehicle was being used for at the time of the crash or the primary use for the bus if not in service at the time of the crash.

fields.name: V23 Emergency Response
fields.description: Subfield 1 indicates operation of any motor vehicle that is legally authorized by a government authority to respond to emergencies with or without the use of emergency warning equipment, such as a police vehicle, fire truck, or ambulance while engaged in such response.

fields.name: V24 Motor Vehicle Posted or Statutory Speed Limit
fields.description: The posted or statutory speed limit for this motor vehicle, just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash.

fields.name: V25 Trafficway Flow
fields.description: Identifies whether the trafficway associated with this vehicle serves one-way or two-way traffic, just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash.

fields.name: V26 Median Barrier Presence
fields.description: Identifies whether the trafficway associated with this vehicle included a median barrier, just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash.

fields.name: V27 Number of Open Lanes in Vehicle’s Environment
fields.type: Select one or specify number of lanes
fields.description: Total number of open lanes in this motor vehicle’s environment, just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash, including through lanes, turn lanes, acceleration or deceleration lanes, HOT or HOV lanes, or any other lanes.

fields.name: V28 Roadway Alignment
fields.description: The geometric or layout characteristics of the roadway in the direction of travel for this vehicle, just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash.

fields.name: V29 Roadway Grade
fields.description: The inclination characteristics of the roadway in the direction of travel for this vehicle, just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash.

fields.name: V30 Roadway Surface Condition
fields.description: The roadway surface condition for this vehicle, just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash.

fields.name: V31 Traffic Control Device
fields.description: The traffic control device (TCD) applicable to this motor vehicle, just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash.

fields.name: V32 Device Functioning
fields.description: Identifies whether the traffic control device recorded for this vehicle in the data element TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE was functioning properly just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash.

fields.name: V33 Vehicle Status Prior to Critical Event
fields.description: The controlled maneuver for this motor vehicle, just prior to this vehicle’s involvement in the crash.

fields.name: V34 Initial Contact Point
fields.description: The approximate contact point on this vehicle associated with this vehicle’s first harmful event.

fields.name: V35 Damaged Areas
fields.description: Identifies all areas damaged on the vehicle as a result of this crash.

fields.name: V36 Extent of Damage
fields.description: Identifies the extent to which the damage identified in DAMAGED AREAS affects the vehicle’s operability rather than the cost to repair.

fields.name: V37 Sequence of Events
fields.description: Events in sequence related to this motor vehicle, including non-harmful events, non-collision harmful events, and collision events.

fields.name: V38 Most Harmful Event for This Motor Vehicle
fields.description: The event that resulted in the most severe injury or, if no injury, the greatest property damage involving this motor vehicle.

fields.name: V39 Hit-and-Run
fields.description: Refers to cases where the motor vehicle in-transport is a contact vehicle in the crash and either the vehicle or the driver departs the scene without the driver stopping to render aid or report the crash.

fields.name: V40 Vehicle Towed
fields.description: Identifies whether the vehicle was towed or carried from the scene of the crash.

fields.name: V41 Contributing Circumstances, Motor Vehicle
fields.description: Pre-existing motor vehicle defects or maintenance conditions that may have contributed to the occurrence or severity of the crash.

fields.name: V42 Vehicle Underride or Override
fields.description: Indicates whether this vehicle experienced an underride or override with another vehicle during the crash. An underride refers to this motor vehicle sliding under another motor vehicle during a crash. An override refers to this motor vehicle riding up over another motor vehicle during a crash.

fields.name: V43 Fire Occurrence
fields.description: Identifies whether a fire in any way related to the crash occurred in this vehicle.

fields.name: V44 Related Factors – Vehicle Level
fields.description: Records factors related to this vehicle to identify and track ongoing or emerging issues associated with these vehicle characteristics.

fields.name: D1 Driver Presence
fields.description: Identifies whether a driver was present in this vehicle at the time of the crash.

fields.name: D2 Driver Address
fields.description: No selection rule stated. The address of the driver of this vehicle.

fields.name: D3 Driver License Jurisdiction

title: Water Quality Portal / WQX result retrieval profiles (Site, Sample Results Physical/Chemical)
publisher: U.S. EPA and U.S. Geological Survey (Water Quality Portal, National Water Quality Monitoring Council)
recordDescription: Discrete water-quality monitoring data: monitoring locations (sites) and sample activity results (characteristic, value, unit, method, detection limits) from EPA WQX and USGS NWIS.
